name: German Boxes and Packstations
description: A Postfach with its number in pairs, short and five digits long, with Nr., abbreviated, in capitals and under a firm's name, and a Packstation and a Postfiliale. Original cases written for this corpus from Deutsche Post's addressing guidance, described in our own words; the postcodes are in GeoNames' list for Germany (CC BY 4.0).
